caption: A car drives onto a frozen pond, its front wheels are turned sharply, and the car keeps sliding straight ahead instead of turning.

sa.check: A car drives onto a frozen pond.
Its front wheels are turned sharply.
The car keeps sliding straight ahead instead of turning.
The wheels are turned first and the straight slide continues afterwards.

pc.expect: The car's path barely changes while the wheels point sideways; it carries on along its old line.
pc.fail: The car turns crisply to follow the wheels as it would on dry road; or it turns the opposite way to the wheels; or it stops dead when the wheels are turned.

pc.expect: The car slides under its own momentum; any swing of the rear is gradual, and nothing changes its motion without acting on it.
pc.fail: The car jinks sideways with the wheels straight; or it speeds up while sliding; or it reverses.

pc.expect: On the ice the tyres skid rather than grip; the car may drift and the rear may swing out slowly.
pc.fail: The tyres bite and the car pivots sharply; or the car tilts up onto two wheels; or the ice cracks open and swallows a wheel.

pc.expect: The car stays flat on the ice throughout.
pc.fail: The car lifts off the surface; or it sinks through the ice; or it tilts and stays tilted with nothing holding it.

pc.expect: One car keeps its shape on the pond.
pc.fail: The car vanishes or a second one appears; or it passes through the bank or a tree; or it turns into another vehicle.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car's colour, the ice and the shore stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the pond's edge moves between frames; or the trees on the shore rearrange.
